meaning: Routing catalog only. No count here represents qualified Norwich integrations.

gmp.limitation: Confirm the actual account, generation meter, credit lines and contract rate.

smarthub.limitation: Qualify each utility and meter. Bill-credit mode requires actual statement credit/excess semantics and a verified parser. Usage, export and prorated bill totals are not measured generation. Monthly only until quarterly support is implemented.

eversource.limitation: The current collector emits no bill records. Login or meter capture does not establish bill-credit extraction.

cmp.limitation: The current collector emits no bill records. Community allocation statements require a separate verified source and mapping.

unknown.limitation: Discover the official portal and source contract before building or enabling a connector.
